# The warnings of the Compilers workflow's Clang job "with warnings": a
# Release build of the library, its tests and its examples with -Werror, the
# hardening flags and the flags below, which come after the -Wno-* flags of
# CMakeLists.txt. Main builds without any of these warnings.

# -Wextra, but for the warnings of -Wextra listed at the end.
-Wextra
-Wno-unused-parameter
-Wno-sign-compare
-Wno-missing-field-initializers

# Format strings: -Wformat=2 adds -Wformat-security and -Wformat-y2k.
-Wformat=2
-Wno-format-nonliteral
-Wformat-non-iso
-Wformat-pedantic
-Wformat-type-confusion
-Wmissing-format-attribute

# Memory, objects and pointers.
-Warray-bounds-pointer-arithmetic
-Wcast-function-type
-Wcast-function-type-strict
-Wnull-dereference
-Wpacked
-Wpointer-arith

# Conversions.
-Wbitfield-enum-conversion
-Wliteral-conversion
-Wnull-conversion
-Wshift-sign-overflow
-Wstring-conversion

# Conditions, loops and unreachable code.
-Widiomatic-parentheses
-Wloop-analysis
-Wtautological-constant-in-range-compare
-Wno-tautological-unsigned-zero-compare
-Wtautological-overlap-compare
-Wunreachable-code-aggressive

# Declarations and the rest.
-Wdate-time
-Wduplicate-enum
-Wextra-semi
-Wfour-char-constants
-Wmissing-include-dirs
-Wunused-local-typedef

# Not turned on yet, each with its findings on main under Clang 21: distinct
# locations in all, and in the library (src/ and include/). A warning comes
# here when its count reaches zero. -Wthread-safety needs the capability
# annotations, which XQUIC does not use.
